declarations.explanation: Membership: apps/web is a browser-rendered App (TanStack Router, client state, createRoot); packages/ui and packages/design are shared web packages whose only consumers are apps/web (in stack) and apps/landing (a Vite-built Site in no stack), so web chooses Vite. Root, landing and mobile are excluded with reasons. Majors: Vite 8.0.16, React 19.2.7, Tailwind CSS 4.3.0, TypeScript 7.0.2 in all three, Vitest 5.0.5 for web's existing suite; ui and design are testless and declare no runner. Root packageManager pnpm@11.28.9, one root pnpm-lock.yaml, engines.node ^24 || ^26, oxlint 1.90.0 and Prettier 3.9.10 at the root. validate: each Project's validate runs Prettier, type-aware oxlint, TypeScript 7 and Dependency Cruiser; web adds route/message generation, Vitest and the build; design adds check:theme; ui adds ui:check, which compares committed bytes with registry-manifest.json offline and reports changed, missing and unexpected files (exercised by scripts/registry.test.mjs). CI: CI / JavaScript (Node 24) and (Node 26) run pnpm check:js, which runs all three validate scripts, plus knip; CI / Required needs the matrix, repository and service and fails on any non-success. Both passed on polity #92's head. shadcn: packages/ui holds components.json (base-nova, lucide) with shadcn 4.13.0 exact; ui:add/ui:update invoke the pinned CLI and record the refresh set, ui:update refreshes only recorded components and never --all; components/ui holds unmodified CLI output using package-private # aliases. Consumers import through app-local components/app wrappers (oxlint no-restricted-imports); package wrappers are one-line re-exports. Shared heading-font effects live in styles.css as data-slot rules in @layer components. Colour tokens sit in :root and .dark in both themes and the generator no longer emits a prefers-color-scheme switch. Setup and validation in docs/development/README.md names these tools and commands. Before/after screenshots and keyboard notes on main and the migration head showed no appearance or interaction regressions.
